source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting reportable workplace accidents

1. Start with the incident records.
2.
completion:
List date, time, and specific location of the incident.
3. Document the names, job titles, and contact information for all involved individuals, including witnesses.
4. Describe the sequence of events and how the incident occurred in your own words.
5. Identify the tasks being performed when the incident occurred and whether these were part of the regular job duties.
6. If safety procedures or equipment were involved, note their condition and whether they were used properly.
7. Include a description of the injuries sustained, with as much detail as possible (e.g., which part of the body was injured, nature and severity of injuries).
8. Record any immediate action that was taken (e.g., first aid provided, emergency services called).
9. Document if the injured person received medical treatment, who provided it (on-site nurse, emergency responders, etc.,) and where (on-site, hospital, etc.).
10. Note any equipment or environment changes made after
